A01.note: - To me, this is a high priority change because this is one of the first screens that people land on. I think the date picker at the top, the days of the week, etc., could feel and look more like a slider, like a radial.... I feel like we could be leveraging more design best practices from Apple as an example, like leveraging their liquid and frosted glass. Making the date dial feel more like it spins so to speak. I think it's round maybe. And what happens if someone chooses a dinner that doesn't have a picture? That experience needs to be optimized too.

A02.note: This screen is just really lackluster. Doesn't really provide much value. Why not show like analytics on this page? More insight based as well.
